'''2003 Origins''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Columbus, Ohio (June 2003). Its Star Wars CCG main event was the Origins 2003 DPC Championship, the second event of the Players Committee and DeckTech's DPC Championship Series, played on Saturday 28 June 2003 at the Greater Columbus Convention Center; [[Andrew Howard]] directed it, and [[Joe Giannetti|Joseph Giannetti]] and [[Matt Scott]] qualified for Day 2 of the [[2003 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-events03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20031009215036/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/events.htm 2003 Events], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 9 October 2003.</ref><ref name="pc-origins03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030605060430/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/origins05212003.htm SWCCG Player's Committee @ Origins 2003], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 5 June 2003.</ref> The winner was promised $500, with cash for the rest of the top 4 and a virtual card design for 2nd place.<ref name="pc-origins03" /> On Friday 27 June at 6 PM the Committee and DeckTech staged a "Grudge Match" between the #1 and #2 rated players in the world, [[Brian Hunter]] and [[Hayes Hunter]]; its result has not been found.<ref name="pc-jun03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20031016172417/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/june03archives.htm June 03 Updates], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 16 October 2003.</ref> Decklists below were recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Columbus, Ohio
* '''Dates:''' 27–28 June 2003 (DPC Championship 28 June)<ref name="pc-events03" />
* '''Venue:''' Greater Columbus Convention Center<ref name="pc-events03" />
* '''Convention:''' 26–29 June 2003, Greater Columbus Convention Center, 400 North High Street, Columbus<ref name="pc-origins03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifiers:''' [[Joe Giannetti|Joseph Giannetti]], [[Matt Scott]]<ref name="pc-events03" />

== Players Committee events ==

The Players Committee scheduled four Star Wars CCG events at Origins 2003:<ref name="pc-origins03" /><ref name="pc-origins03b" />
* Thursday 26 June, 6 pm: [[Sealed Deck]] ([[Secret Squirrel]]), $10 entry; foils and boosters for all.
* Friday 27 June, 6 pm: Constructed ([[Classic]]), $5 entry; foils, boosters and an uncut sheet.
* Saturday 28 June, 10 am: Origins DPC Championship, $20 entry; 8 games of Swiss and a playoff between the top 4, with $500 to the champion, cash prizes for 2nd to 4th, 2 byes into Day 2 of Worlds and the chance to create a virtual card for 2nd place.<ref name="pc-origins03b">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/origins05212003.htm SWCCG Player's Committee @ Origins 2003], swccgpc.com (21 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040604154458/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/origins05212003.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
* Sunday 29 June, 11 am: Origins Team Tournament, $25 per team; uncut sheets for the winning team.

When the Players Committee first announced the Origins DPC Championship on 6 February 2003, as the first confirmed event in a series of championship-level tournaments co-sponsored with DeckTech, the prizes were to include a trophy for the 2003 Origins Champion, Day 2 byes for the champion and runner-up, uncut sheets, foils and cards, with a guaranteed $500 to the winner.<ref name="pc-champ0206">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/championshipnews02062003.htm 2003 Championship Circuit Opens in One Month], swccgpc.com (6 February 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030424053234/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/championshipnews02062003.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

The Committee's May 2003 announcement named [[Brian Hunter]], [[Hayes Hunter]], [[Clint Hays]], [[Jonny Chu|Jonathan Chu]], [[Justin Desai]], [[Mike Gemme|Michael Gemme]], [[Greg Shaw]], [[Brian Fred]] and PC Advocate [[Eric Olson]] among the notable players who would attend, and said that the [[Kashyyyk Train of Dominance]] would be there to defend its title.<ref name="pc-origins03" />

The DPC Championship was the first Players Committee event at which [[DeckTech]] Premium Members received a discount: 20% off the entry fee for all events co-sponsored by the Committee and DeckTech, for players who joined by 23 June 2003. [[Neal Razi]] was the contact for the program.<ref name="pc-premium0612">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/originspremium06122003.htm DeckTech Premium Members Get Special Opportunity at Origins 2003!], swccgpc.com (12 June 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040620164159/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/originspremium06122003.htm Internet Archive]</ref> At Origins DeckTech offered Premium Memberships for $15 and was to donate $1 from each one to the Players Committee, which announced a small "thank you" prize for everyone who signed up there.<ref name="pc-premium0624">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/originspremium06242003.htm Decktech Offers Premium Memberships at Origins!], swccgpc.com (24 June 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040620114821/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/originspremium06242003.htm Internet Archive]</ref> DeckTech also put up free Premium Memberships for the top two players of the DPC Championship: three months for the winner and one month for the runner-up.<ref name="pc-jun03" />
